definition.purpose: Master classification of server systems used for computing, networking, applications, data, communication, security and digital services.

server_categories.name: Web Server
server_categories.purpose: Serves websites and HTTP-based web resources.

server_categories.name: Application Server
server_categories.purpose: Runs application business logic and application services.

server_categories.name: Database Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides database storage, processing and access services.

server_categories.name: File Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides centralized file storage and file access.

server_categories.name: Mail Server
server_categories.purpose: Handles electronic mail delivery and mailbox services.

server_categories.name: DNS Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides Domain Name System resolution and DNS management services.

server_categories.name: Proxy Server
server_categories.purpose: Acts as an intermediary between clients and other servers.

server_categories.name: Reverse Proxy Server
server_categories.purpose: Receives client requests and forwards them to backend services.

server_categories.name: API Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides programmatic interfaces for applications and services.

server_categories.name: Authentication Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides identity authentication services.

server_categories.name: Authorization Server
server_categories.purpose: Controls access permissions and authorization decisions.

server_categories.name: Storage Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides centralized storage services.

server_categories.name: Backup Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides centralized backup and recovery services.

server_categories.name: Media Server
server_categories.purpose: Processes and delivers digital media.

server_categories.name: Messaging Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides messaging and communication services.

server_categories.name: API Gateway Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides a controlled entry point for multiple APIs and backend services.

server_categories.name: Load Balancer
server_categories.purpose: Distributes incoming traffic across multiple backend systems.

server_categories.name: Monitoring Server
server_categories.purpose: Collects and analyzes infrastructure and application monitoring data.

server_categories.name: Logging Server
server_categories.purpose: Centralizes system and application logs.

server_categories.name: Container Server
server_categories.purpose: Runs containerized applications and services.

server_categories.name: Virtualization Server
server_categories.purpose: Runs and manages virtual machines.

server_categories.name: Game Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides multiplayer game session and game-state services.

server_categories.name: Search Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides indexing and search capabilities.

server_categories.name: AI Server
server_categories.purpose: Provides computing and serving infrastructure for artificial intelligence workloads.
